text:
alex: Morning — e2e perf gate failed on the nightly run. p50 +18%, p95 +35%, throughput -22% vs baseline. Run id 789342. CI link: https://ci.redwood/789342 :eyes:
ci-bot: Perf gate triggered for e2e-perf-suite (run 789342). Alerts sent to #eng-runtime oncall.
maya: ack. any obvious suspect? recent infra or model change?
alex: No infra deploys since last green. Last deploy window ~1768140000. Noted we rolled quantization tweak (commit b3f4c2) two days ago. Also KV cache patch merged yesterday (PR #412).
jamal: i saw weird startup cpus on the perf machines earlier — KV cache cold-start could spike p99. can we rerun with warmup?
alex: requesting rerun + warmup flag. filing bisect if rerun still red. cc @sasha
sasha: happy to bisect. list of suspected commits?
alex: suspects: b3f4c2 (quant tweak), 9a1d0e (runtime scheduler tweak), e5c7b1 (kv-cache init fix). Also CI infra image 2025-11-10 (image:ci-20251110)
eric-oncall: I can spin up a fresh node pool to isolate infra. will do health checks on node latency and network.
sasha: I'll start a git-bisect on the perf branch. need the bad run sha and good baseline sha.
alex: bad run sha = HEAD@{run=789342} -> commit 3fa2d9. Last known good 3f1a8c (from run 789100)
maya: can you paste the minimal rerun command?
alex: sure:
```bash
./ci/rerun_e2e --suite e2e-perf-suite --run 789342 --warmup-seconds 120 --env PERF_BASELINE=3f1a8c
```
alex: also please enable KV_CACHE_WARMUP=1 in env for the rerun.
ci-bot: Rerun queued as 789343. Notifying eng-runtime.
jamal: I'll watch the run and capture kernel/cpu traces if it flaps.
sasha: starting bisect now. Will post intermediate findings in this thread. ETA ~45m.
eric-oncall: node pool spun up, all nodes pass kernel version/driver checks. no obvious network packet loss. :white_check_mark: 
ci-bot: Rerun 789343 started on perf-cluster-7.
maya: thanks. if rerun is green, we'll mark kv-cache warmup as mitigation and follow up with proper fix.
alex: if rerun still fails, sasha to bisect; jamal to attach perf traces. I can revert kv-cache PR temporarily if bisect points there.
sasha: update: bisect narrowed to 9a1d0e -> runtime scheduler tweak. reproduces locally on my laptop with micro-bench harness. p95 regressed ~30% w/ same seed.
jamal: interesting. scheduler change touched batching logic — could increase latency for small sequence lengths.
maya: ok plan: revert scheduler tweak on perf branch, run full e2e. sasha, can you open a PR with revert + benchmark results?
sasha: will do. PR draft: rollback/runtime-scheduler-revert, includes microbench numbers and bisect log.
alex: excellent. thanks all. filing a postmortem if PR lands. tagging this as root-cause=scheduler-batching in our incident tracker.
ci-bot: Rerun 789343 completed: PASSED. Note: warmup and KV_CACHE_WARMUP=1 were set.
alex: rerun passed — suggests cold-start KV or warmup contributed. however bisect still points to scheduler tweak for the regression during normal runs. need follow-up: combine revert + warmup for stability.
maya: agreed. action items: 1) sasha open revert PR, 2) eng-ml/runtime team to review batching heuristics, 3) add warmup option to perf pipeline.
eric-oncall: logged infra checks done. nothing to change there.
jamal: uploading perf traces to https://artifacts.redwood/789343/traces, label "kv-warmup".
sasha: PR opened https://github.com/redwood/.../pull/623 — adding reviewers @maya @alex.
alex: thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
end.
